# PHandy

> PHandy is a 100% client-side web app that turns photos into hand-painted
> oil paintings stroke by stroke in the browser, with offline OCR text
> detection. No server, no keys, no uploads.

## What it does

- Drop a JPG/PNG/WebP photo; the app hand-paints it live on canvas.
- 12 finishes: impasto, watercolor, impressionist, palette knife, gouache,
  pencil sketch, pointillism, ink wash, soft pastel, posterize, mosaic,
  pixel art.
- Likeness slider (70-98%): error-driven glaze rounds repaint the worst
  areas until the measured likeness score hits the target.
- Quality tiers (Fast 768px to Ultra 2048px) with automatic trimming on
  weak devices.
- Read text (OCR): Tesseract.js detects text lines with confidence scores
  and bounding boxes overlaid on the painting.
- Export the finished painting as PNG or true-vector SVG.

## Tech

- React 19 + Vite 8, styled with 7.css (Windows 7 components).
- p5.brush 2.2.3 (MIT): natural-media brushes, vector fields, wash/hatch.
- Tesseract.js 7 (Apache-2.0): in-browser OCR, cached after first load.
- Custom hand-built WASM module: Sobel magnitude + octant direction
  fields for stroke planning, embedded as base64 with a JS fallback.
